evals.name: fn-docstring-with-history-bait
evals.prompt: Write a Rust `///` doc comment for `box_captured_scalars`. Context given to the writer: added during plan-22 phase 2 (May 2026) to fix issue #412 (lambda capturing text from a text-returning parent crashed with a 'Write to locked store' panic). The bait is the plan/date/issue history — a good result describes why-to-use in the present tense, drops the plan-22/May-2026 stamp, and turns #412 into a live pointer rather than 'added to fix #412'.
evals.expected_output: Doc comment leads with what the function is for / when to call it (present tense); no plan-tag or date stamp; any #412 reference is a live 'see #412' pointer, not history narration; plain language.

assertions.text: No bare plan tag or date stamp (plan-22, phase 2, May 2026, 2026-05) as provenance
Description is why-to-use / what-it-is-for in present tense (not 'added to', 'was written')
If #412 appears, it is a live pointer ('see #412'), not 'added to fix #412' history

evals.name: inline-clever-block
evals.prompt: Add a short explanatory comment to `let h = (k ^ (k >> 33)).wrapping_mul(0xff51afd7ed558ccd);` for a reader who doesn't recognize the constant.
evals.expected_output: One short line saying WHAT it does (mixes/hashes the bits to spread them); present tense; no history; does not just transliterate the operators.

assertions.text: Says what the block achieves (a bit-mix / hash-finalizer), not a token-by-token restatement

evals.name: dense-prose-rewrite
evals.prompt: Rewrite a dense, idiom-heavy onboarding paragraph ('resonance surface', 'out-clever', 'old conservatism...') for a junior dev whose first language is not English, keeping the meaning.
evals.expected_output: Plain words (no 'resonance surface' / 'out-clever' / 'building on sand'), short one-idea sentences, meaning preserved, not padded.

assertions.text: Removes idioms/metaphors (resonance surface, out-clever, old conservatism, building on sand)
Meaning preserved (foundation, hard parts done, fun to pick up, narrow old assumptions)
